limits: RegCreateKeyExA is an isolated scripted operating-system boundary; all nine arguments, output handles, disposition writes and status codes are observed without changing the system registry.
RegQueryValueExA is an isolated scripted operating-system boundary; all six arguments, caller-provided byte capacity, type, data and length writes are observed without reading system settings.
The five whole functions retain their original intervals with no coverage exemptions; they call no external original CRT functions and no game function is replaced by a fixture.
Boundary readiness is not native integration or proof of continuous menu-to-game flow; caller startup and source-path behavior remains independently owned.
notes: Boundary reviewed against hash-checked v1.0 corpus and caller instructions; all five results are consumed u32 values. The key wrapper is stdcall with three arguments because incoming ECX is overwritten. Object layout, physical stack aliases, read-only string requirements and case guidance are in the ignored packet NOTES.md.
